stemMarkdown: Find the highest power of $2$ that divides $20!$.
solutionMarkdown: By Legendre's formula, add the floors of $20$ divided by successive powers of $2$: \left\lfloor \dfrac{20}{2} \right\rfloor = 10 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{20}{4} \right\rfloor = 5 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{20}{8} \right\rfloor = 2 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{20}{16} \right\rfloor = 1. The total is $18$.
